query: I gave a business loan to my friend and his repayment cheque bounced with remarks insufficient funds
rationale: Standard dishonour of cheque for insufficiency of funds under Section 138 Negotiable Instruments Act.

query: What is the legal timeline to send a statutory demand notice after receiving cheque return memo from bank?
rationale: Section 138 clause (b) specifies 30-day notice requirement from date of receipt of bank information.

query: Purchased a brand new television from retail electronics store but screen has dead pixels and dealer refused to replace it under 1 year warranty
rationale: Deficiency in goods/service under Section 2(11) and consumer complaint procedure under Section 35 CPA 2019.

query: How much compensation can I claim in District Consumer Forum for defective medical equipment costing 15 lakh rupees?
rationale: Section 34 defines pecuniary jurisdiction of District Commission up to 1 crore rupees (now 50 lakh as per amended rules).
human_review_reason: Pecuniary jurisdiction rules were amended via Consumer Protection (Jurisdiction of Commission) Rules 2021; statutory section text states up to 1 crore.

query: Where should I file a formal complaint against an airline for cancelling my flight without refund or alternative arrangement?
rationale: Deficiency in service by airline under Section 2(11) and complaint filing under Section 35 CPA 2019.

query: Received an SMS with APK link claiming electricity bill overdue, upon clicking 75000 rupees was debited from SBI account
rationale: Cheating by personation using computer resource under Section 66D IT Act, and cheating under Section 318 BNS 2023.

query: Someone created a fake Instagram profile using my personal photos and mobile number to impersonate me online
rationale: Identity theft under Section 66C and personation under Section 66D of Information Technology Act 2000.

query: My landlord is refusing to refund my 60000 security deposit after I vacated the rental flat in good condition with all utility bills paid
rationale: Lessor/lessee mutual rights and obligations under Section 108 TPA 1882; potential criminal breach of trust under Section 316 BNS if dishonest conversion occurred.
human_review_reason: Landlord security deposit disputes fall on boundary between civil debt recovery/State rent control acts and criminal breach of trust.

query: Landlord gave me only 3 days oral notice to vacate the rented house without any written agreement
rationale: Section 106 TPA mandates 15 days written notice for monthly tenancy in absence of written contract.

query: What are tenant rights regarding property repairs when landlord completely neglects roof leakage?
rationale: Section 108(f) TPA permits lessee to make necessary repairs and deduct expenses from rent if lessor neglects after notice.

query: My husband and his parents beat me regularly, locked me in bedroom and threw me out of matrimonial home
rationale: Domestic violence definition under Section 3 PWDVA, application to Magistrate under Section 12 PWDVA, and voluntarily causing hurt under Section 115 BNS 2023.

query: How can an abused woman obtain an urgent residence order and protection order from judicial magistrate?
rationale: Section 12 of PWDVA 2005 governs application to Magistrate for orders including protection and residence orders.

query: Local police station officer refuses to write down my FIR regarding armed robbery and physical assault
rationale: Section 173 BNSS 2023 governs mandatory registration of information in cognizable offences (FIR) and remedy of sending substance to Superintendent of Police.

query: How can a citizen submit an electronic FIR or Zero FIR under the new criminal procedure code?
rationale: Section 173(1) of BNSS 2023 explicitly codifies electronic communication of information and zero FIR procedures.

query: An undertrial accused has been in jail for more than two years without trial for an offence with maximum 3 year imprisonment
rationale: Section 479 BNSS 2023 provides maximum detention period for undertrial prisoners and mandatory release on personal bond.

query: What is the legal punishment for intentional murder and mob lynching under the new penal law?
rationale: Section 103 BNS 2023 prescribes punishment for murder and sub-section (2) specifically penalizes mob lynching by groups of five or more.

query: A neighbour attacked my brother with a wooden stick causing severe bruising and bleeding during an argument
rationale: Voluntarily causing hurt under Section 115 BNS 2023 (formerly Section 323 IPC).

query: My contractor took 5 lakh advance for house construction, stopped answering phone calls and diverted funds to personal gambling
rationale: Criminal breach of trust under Section 316 BNS and cheating under Section 318 BNS 2023.
human_review_reason: Requires scrutiny of initial dishonest intention at inception (cheating §318) vs subsequent misappropriation of entrusted advance (§316).

query: Invested money in an online crypto doubling scheme after promoter promised guaranteed 20 percent weekly returns
rationale: Fraudulent inducement and cheating under Section 318 BNS 2023.

query: A local goon threatened to burn down my grocery shop and kill my children if I do not pay monthly extortion
rationale: Criminal intimidation under Section 351 BNS 2023 (formerly IPC Section 503/506).

query: A bike parked outside my residential building was stolen overnight with lock broken
rationale: Theft under Section 303 BNS 2023 (formerly IPC Section 378/379).

query: A man grabbed a woman's dupatta and passed vulgar abusive remarks in a public bus
rationale: Assault or use of criminal force to woman with intent to outrage her modesty under Section 74 BNS 2023.

query: The cheating incident occurred in March 2024 before the new Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita came into force. Which law applies?
rationale: Repeal and savings clauses under Section 358 BNS and Section 531 BNSS preserve applicability of IPC 1860 for offences committed prior to July 1, 2024.

query: How do I prove WhatsApp chat screenshots and CCTV video footage in court as legal evidence?
rationale: Section 61 (admissibility of electronic records) and Section 63 (certificate requirement for electronic records, formerly Section 65B IEA) under Bharatiya Sakshya Adhiniyam 2023.

query: What are the mandatory requirements for an electronic evidence certificate under Section 63 of Bharatiya Sakshya Adhiniyam?
rationale: Section 63 BSA 2023 provides detailed statutory conditions and certificate schedule for electronic record admissibility.

query: How can a poor domestic maid with low income get a free government lawyer for her maintenance case?
rationale: Section 12 of Legal Services Authorities Act 1987 provides free legal aid to women irrespective of income, and low-income persons.

query: Who is eligible for free legal aid under Section 12 of the Legal Services Authorities Act 1987?
rationale: Section 12 LSAA lists statutory categories including SC/ST, women, children, disabled, custody, and income threshold.

query: How can I file an application to municipal corporation demanding road repair budget and contractor tender copies?
rationale: Section 6 of Right to Information Act 2005 governs requests for obtaining information from public authorities.

query: Public Information Officer did not reply to my RTI application within 30 days. What is the statutory time limit?
rationale: Section 7 RTI Act 2005 mandates disposal of requests within thirty days, or 48 hours if concerning life and liberty.

query: What fee should be paid when submitting an RTI query to Central Government department?
rationale: Section 6(1) RTI Act prescribes application along with such fee as may be prescribed.

query: Bank customer account debited with unauthorized transfer after SIM swap fraud by cyber criminals
rationale: Identity theft under §66C IT Act, computer personation under §66D IT Act, and cheating under §318 BNS 2023.
human_review_reason: Overlapping penal provisions across IT Act 2000 special law and general penal code BNS 2023.

query: Police inspector demanding money and refusing to take my complaint about motorcycle theft
rationale: Refusal to register cognizable theft FIR governed by Section 173 BNSS; substantive offence of theft under Section 303 BNS.

query: Online shopping portal delivered empty soap box instead of ordered Apple iPhone and customer care refuses refund
rationale: Deficiency in service / unfair trade practice under CPA 2019 §2(11) / §35, concurrent with criminal cheating under BNS §318.
human_review_reason: Complainant can pursue consumer redressal for refund/compensation or criminal prosecution for delivery fraud.

query: Is an undertrial entitled to bail if they have completed half of the maximum sentence prescribed for the offence?
rationale: Section 479 BNSS provides release on personal bond upon completing half (or one-third for first-time offenders) of maximum detention period.

query: Husband demanding dowry and inflicting severe mental cruelty and threats on wife in shared household
rationale: Domestic violence under Section 3 PWDVA (explicitly includes dowry demands), Magistrate application under §12 PWDVA, and criminal intimidation under §351 BNS.
human_review_reason: In addition to PWDVA remedies, cruelty by husband/relatives may invoke criminal provisions (historically Section 498A IPC / Section 85-86 BNS 2023 not in current 26-seed set).
